description:
## Why

The whole point of the harness. Comparing N oracle verdicts and bucketing into useful categories is what produces actionable signal.

## What

In `pkix-difftest/src/classify.rs` and `pkix-difftest/src/report.rs`:

1. **Comparison classes** (per bead PKIX-7nsf):
   - `Agreement` — all oracles (including pkix-path) agree (Pass or Fail).
   - `StricterThanWild` — pkix-path `Fail`, ≥1 oracle `Pass` (we reject; openssl/pyca accept).
   - `LooserThanWild` — pkix-path `Pass`, ≥1 oracle `Fail`.
   - `OracleDivergence` — pkix-path agrees with at least one oracle, oracles among themselves disagree.
   - `DiagnosticDivergence` — all agree on Pass/Fail, but the `Fail` reason strings differ. (Low priority bucket.)

2. **Class precedence**: `LooserThanWild` > `StricterThanWild` > `OracleDivergence` > `DiagnosticDivergence` > `Agreement`. (Worst-first.)

3. **Reporter**:
   - `report.rs::write_markdown(out: &mut impl Write, classified: &[Classified])` — emits a markdown report with a summary table and one section per class containing a representative sample (configurable count, default 10).
   - `report.rs::write_json(out, classified)` — full machine-readable dump.
   - Both writers are pure (no I/O beyond the supplied writer).

4. **CLI integration**: `pkix-difftest run <corpus-spec> --oracles openssl,pyca --output-md report.md --output-json report.json`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Classifier covers all 5 classes with property-based or table-driven tests (≥3 cases per class).
- [ ] Class precedence is implemented and unit-tested.
- [ ] Markdown report opens cleanly in a renderer; tables are valid GFM.
- [ ] JSON report parses with `serde_json::from_str::<Vec<ClassifiedJson>>`.
- [ ] When PKITS provides ground truth (`expected_verdict_opt = Some`), the report flags ground-truth disagreements as a separate top-level category (orthogonal to oracle disagreement).

## Notes

- The classifier should not assume a fixed oracle list — it accepts `Vec<(OracleName, Verdict)>` so future oracles (BC, Apple) drop in without code change.
- Diagnostic-divergence bucket is the dumping ground for noise. v1 emits a count only by default (samples optional flag).
